facts.business: Real Touch Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the RBI, primarily focused on secured lending including Loan Against Property (LAP), Real Estate Finance, and MSME lending, while selectively funding other NBFCs engaged in impact-oriented lending.

segments.name: Secured Lending (LAP, Real Estate Finance, MSME)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The share of unsecured lending is expected to stabilise in near terms (25-30%) with gradual expansion supported by industry initiatives, borrower discipline and economic recovery.

key_risks: Elevated delinquencies in microfinance sector due to borrower overleveraging and collection challenges
Moderation in unsecured personal lending following regulatory measures
Migration of exposures to Stage 2 under ECL model leading to higher impairment allowances
Concentration risk from strategic investment in Security Receipts (₹12,500 lakh)
Regulatory changes impacting NBFC governance, underwriting, and risk management
